snippet.title: RUMINANT4444 - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
You have 4 days to make things right. Love, nurture, scold, and kill Virions until you’ve made amends: I’m sorry, Laetitia.

RUMINANT 4444 is now out on itch.io!

Game by Mia Buser (miurbu)
Music by Moritz Lieberherr
Sound Design by Demian Wyssmann
